d: Santal hul kranti bhartiy svatantrata sangram ka ek gauravshali adhyay hai, jise 1855-56 men siddo-kanhu ke netritv men aadivasi yoddhaon ne angreji shoshan ke viruddh chhera tha. is aitihasik vidroh men phulo-jhano jaisi vir mahilaon ne bhi mahatvapurn bhumika nibhaee. "hul johar!" ke nare se shuru huaa yah aandolan aadivasi asmita aur svatantrata ki laraee ka pratik bana. bhognadih men janme in viron ne mahajni vyavastha aur british daman ke khilaph sangharsh karte hue shahadat di. yah kranti na keval jharkhand balki bharat ke svatantrata sangram ki prerna srot bani.
